origins.section: An Immutable Argument Can't Be Changed, So a Method That Computes a New Value Returns It
Java Copies Every Argument, So Assigning to a Parameter Never Reaches the Caller's Variable
Java Copies Every Argument, So Assigning to a Parameter Never Reaches the Caller's Variable
A Method That Keeps Its Argument Keeps the Caller's Object
A Method That Changes Its Argument Makes That Change Part of Its Contract

gates.says: all 5 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-loyalty-long: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-loyalty-long: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-loyalty-long: Page: '`BigDecimal`, `String` and the wrappers have no method that changes the object. ... `visits++` unboxes, adds and assigns the boxed result to the parameter ... The only "change" these methods can make is an assignment to the parameter, which the caller never sees.' So the parameter (and the log) holds 1450 and the caller keeps 1200. The page shows ++ on Integer and += on String, not += on Long, but the wrappers sentence covers Long.
recorded.prompt:q-calibrate-array: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-calibrate-array: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-calibrate-array: Page: 'for a reference type it is the reference'; the Reference table lists array as a mutable object where changing it through the parameter means 'the caller sees the change', so r[0]=0 reaches the caller. addDefaults: 'Line (1) points `tags` at a new list, so line (2) adds to that list' and Summary: 'code after that assignment works on the new object'. Gap: the page never mentions Arrays.copyOf, so the reader relies on the option's own words that it makes a new array.
recorded.prompt:q-final-emails: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-final-emails: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-final-emails: Page: 'Declaring the parameter `final` turns the assignment into a compile error (`final parameter cart may not be assigned`). It does nothing about `cart.clear()`, which still compiles.' replaceAll is the same kind of call as clear().
recorded.prompt:q-route-record: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-route-record: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-route-record: Page: 'a record's implicit constructor stores its components as given' and the record line of output shows the shared-buffer bug: 'Each `clear()` rewrote every invoice built before it.' So the route sees the remove.
recorded.prompt:q-picklist-removeif: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-picklist-removeif: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-picklist-removeif: Page: 'every method of a `List.of` list that could change it throws, even when the call would change nothing (`sort` on one element, `removeIf` that matches nothing).'
